source: Cohort ranges are explicit estimates derived from public sources named on or attached to their outcome links.

infant-mortality-cohort-estimate.estimatedFrom: Chay and Greenstone 2003 (NBER w10053, Air Quality, Infant Mortality, and the Clean Air Act of 1970); Chay and Greenstone 2003 (QJE); Gemmill et al. 2025 (JAMA)

working-age-adult-cohort-estimate.estimatedFrom: CBO supplemental estimate for Public Law 119-21 (2025); Sommers et al. 2019 (NEJM); Courtemanche, Marton, Ukert, Yelowitz and Zapata 2017 (JPAM); Cawley, Moriya and Simon 2015

older-adult-medicare-cohort-estimate.estimatedFrom: CMS fact sheet, negotiated prices for initial price applicability year 2026 (2024)

adult-substance-use-condition-estimate.estimatedFrom: Rees, Sabia, Argys, Latshaw and Dave 2019, Journal of Law and Economics 62(1); Doleac and Mukherjee 2022, Journal of Law and Economics 65(2); Chan, Burkhardt and Flyr 2020, Economic Inquiry 58(2); Mathur and Ruhm 2023, Journal of Health Economics 88; CDC WONDER 2022 overdose deaths by drug

youth-cannabis-cohort-estimate.estimatedFrom: Anderson, Hansen, Rees and Sabia 2019 (JAMA Pediatrics); Cerdá et al. 2017 (JAMA Pediatrics)

child-asthma-cohort-estimate.estimatedFrom: Gruenwald, Seals, Knibbs and Hosgood 2022, International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health 20(1)

adult-school-completer-estimate.estimatedFrom: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey adult population (age 18+); Jackson, Johnson and Persico 2016 (QJE)

retirement-age-adult-cohort-estimate.estimatedFrom: Engelhardt and Gruber 2004 (NBER w10466); 20 CFR 404.410; Census P60-287 (2025)

retirement-policy-age-cohort-estimate.estimatedFrom: Mastrobuoni 2009 (JPubE); the outcome link estimates employment among ages 62 to 67 as the Social Security full retirement age rises

recorded-parent-of-young-child-estimate.estimatedFrom: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey table B23008 (own children under age 6); Malik 2018; Baker, Gruber and Milligan 2008

recorded-parent-of-infant-estimate.estimatedFrom: Baum and Ruhm 2016 (JPAM); Rossin-Slater, Ruhm and Waldfogel 2013 (JPAM), return to work within a year of birth
